snippet.title: Poke All Toads -  Trailer
snippet.description:
"Poke ALL Toads" is a puzzle game about mischief. Take control of a band of fairies, start some troubles and escape the amphibian wrath.

To be released in 2024
Developed by SpaceMatra using the Godot Engine.
Music Red Heels (piano version) by TAS
